notes.zh: 伙伴页全面焕新：选伙伴、换伙伴都在 App 内直接完成，不再依赖网页加载，打开更快更稳；新伙伴支持一次多选领养；领养价格按数量阶梯计算，多选更划算；国际支付卡片说明更清楚，付款后可立即检查结果。
notes.en: Buddies page refreshed: pick and switch buddies right inside the app with no web loading - faster and steadier. Multi-select adoption is now supported. Adoption pricing scales by quantity, so picking more saves more. Clearer international payment card, with an instant check after paying.
